items.exampleEn: Please don't talk loudly in the library.
items.exampleZh: 在圖書館裡請不要大聲說話。

items.exampleEn: The street outside my window is very noisy.
The school has a new computer system.
items.exampleZh: 學校有一套新的電腦系統。

items.exampleEn: The prices at this market are low.
Traffic is a major problem in this city.
items.exampleZh: 交通是這座城市的一大問題。

items.exampleEn: This old watch has great value to me.
items.exampleZh: 這支舊手錶對我來說很有價值。

items.exampleEn: My son likes to make model planes.
items.exampleZh: 我兒子喜歡做飛機模型。

items.sentenceEn: The train runs smoothly and quietly.
items.sentenceZh: 這班火車開得又平穩又安靜。

items.audioEn: The restaurant was too noisy, so we ate at home.
items.audioZh: 那家餐廳太吵了，所以我們在家吃。
options: The food there was very bad

items.sentenceEn: He laughed loudly at the joke.
items.sentenceZh: 他聽了那個笑話哈哈大笑。

items.sentenceEn: This is a major change for our team.
items.sentenceZh: 這對我們團隊來說是一個重大的改變。

items.stemEn: Please speak more ____. I can't hear you.
items.stemZh: 請說大聲一點，我聽不到你說話。

items.stemEn: This ring is old, but it has great ____.
items.stemZh: 這枚戒指很舊，但很有價值。

items.passageEn: Last month, our company bought a new computer system. At first, it did not work smoothly. The office was very noisy because people were talking loudly on the phone about problems. It was a major problem for everyone. Now everything is fine. The computers are the newest model, and the price was low. My boss says the system has great value for the company.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們公司買了一套新的電腦系統。一開始系統運作得不順，辦公室非常吵，因為大家都在電話上大聲討論各種問題。這對每個人來說都是個大問題。現在一切都沒事了。這些電腦是最新的機型，價格也很低。我老闆說這套系統對公司很有價值。

questions.questionZh: 一開始辦公室為什麼很吵？
options: 大樓外面正在施工蓋新房子
大家在電話上大聲討論問題

questions.questionZh: 那些新電腦的價格怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 這裡太吵了，我們換個地方吧。
referenceEn: It's too noisy here. Let's go somewhere else.
This place is too noisy. Let's go elsewhere.
rubricZh: 「太吵」可寫例如 too noisy、too loud
「換個地方」可寫例如 go somewhere else、go elsewhere、find another place
提議用 Let's＋原形動詞（例如 Let's go）

items.instructionZh: 用 low 造一個句子，描述一樣很低的東西（例如價格、桌子）。
referenceEn: The water in the river is very low now.
This table is too low for me.
rubricZh: low 可放在 be 動詞後，也可放在名詞前（例如 The prices are low、a low table）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 The prices are、This table is）
